steps.message:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 168 | 1.71 | 1.71
2 | 484 | 7.45 | 9.16
3 | 255 | 15.3 | 24.4
4 | 1109 | 25 | 49.4
5 | 807 | 74.2 | 124
6 | 8895 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as Q-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Reference note: Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station: Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHKH (resistivity sequence 168<484>255<1109>807<8895 gives K-H-K-H; this corrects the file's Q-type label, which does not match the logged resistivity values)
Aquifer depth: 49.4–124 m (Layer 5, 807 ohm-m, underlying the resistive Layer 4 and capped by the very high-resistivity basement/competent unit below)
Recommendation: Target the 49.4–124 m interval for screening, as it represents the main saturated, moderately resistive unit above the hard, highly resistive basal layer; confirm lithology with cuttings/geophysical logging while drilling through this zone, and terminate or case off before penetrating the >8,000 ohm-m basal layer unless bedrock water is specifically sought.
